incumbent: Darline Graham (R, appointed interim senator July 2026; sister of the late Lindsey Graham)
notes: Sen. Lindsey Graham (R) DIED July 11 2026 age 71. Had won renomination in the June primary. Gov. McMaster to appoint an interim successor serving to Jan 3 2027. Special R primary Aug 11, runoff Aug 25; filing Jul 21-28. D nominee Annie Andrews (pediatrician). Prediction markets ~80% R hold as of Jul 13. Cook rating NOT yet re-verified post-death - CONFIRM before publication. | UPDATED 2026-08-14: Aug 11 special primary produced no majority. Graham 32.7%, Norman 24.6%, Rep. Russell Fry 19.6% (eliminated). Graham and Norman advance to an Aug 25 2026 runoff (AP/NBC/CBS/NPR/ABC/PBS, all corroborating). The eventual nominee is UNKNOWN as of 2026-08-14 — do not treat Graham as the settled nominee.
